restaurantName: TING at Shangri-La The Shard, London
bio: Treat yourself to a one-of-a-kind experience in TĪNG restaurant and lounge at Shangri-La The Shard, London. Indulge in a sumptuous Afternoon Tea on 35th floor of The Shard, while enjoying unrivalled views of London's skyline.  Crafted with local ingredients and presented on a stand adorned with opulent gold and blue florals and the Shangri-La’s distinctive ten-year anniversary emblem, this delectable celebration afternoon tea will feature delicious finger sandwiches, followed by London-themed sweet treats including Big Ben at Ten and London Calling as well as TĪNG’s signature miniature Shard building, accompanied by British Cenarth Brie and a tangy berry compote.  Priced at £78 per person, or £88 with a glass of Champagne.  One of London's most sought-after pastimes, Afternoon Tea at Shangri-La The Shard, London is just 2 minutes' walk from London Bridge Station.
